name: ALEKS
line: ALEKS retests in periodic Knowledge Checks; AMP brings each skill back on a fixed schedule in daily practice.

name: Brilliant
line: Brilliant teaches with interactive problems from about grade 4; AMP starts at counting and schedules every review.

name: CK-12
line: CK-12 offers free math books and an AI chat tutor. AMP picks, checks and explains every problem, from counting on.

name: DoodleMath
line: DoodleMath is a game-rich app for grades K-5. AMP runs to precalculus, with stated mastery and review rules.

name: IXL
line: In IXL the learner or an adult picks each skill; AMP picks every next problem and schedules review.

name: Khan Academy
line: Khan Academy is free and the adult plans it; AMP chooses every problem and brings old skills back on a schedule.

name: Math Academy
line: Math Academy starts at grade 4 and teaches in text. AMP starts at counting and adds hints, films and print.

name: Mathletics
line: Mathletics motivates with points, races and games. AMP picks each problem, explains each miss and schedules review.

name: DreamBox Math
line: DreamBox is a K-8 supplement built on discovery. AMP runs through precalculus and explains every answer.

name: Exact Path
line: Exact Path is sold to schools by quote. AMP is open to any family or teacher today, and its rules are public.

name: Freckle
line: Freckle is free practice built for classrooms. AMP is a full program with a stated mastery rule and scheduled review.

name: Happy Numbers
line: Happy Numbers covers PreK to grade 5. AMP runs on to precalculus and brings learned skills back on a schedule.

name: i-Ready
line: i-Ready sells only to schools and sets a lesson path from a test. AMP adapts at every answer, at home or at school.

name: Imagine Math
line: Imagine Math is a school program with no posted price. AMP sells to families and brings skills back on a schedule.

name: MATHia
line: MATHia is a school tutor for grades 6 to 12. AMP is open to families and runs from counting to precalculus.

name: ST Math
line: ST Math teaches with visual puzzles to grade 8. AMP adds lessons, hints and scheduled review through precalculus.

name: Zearn
line: Zearn takes a class through one grade’s lessons in order; AMP finds each learner’s level and schedules review.

name: CTCMath
line: CTCMath teaches by video, then asks the lesson's questions; AMP places each learner and chooses every next problem.

name: Derek Owens
line: Derek Owens teaches each course by recorded lecture. AMP chooses every problem and checks each answer at once.

name: MathHelp.com
line: MathHelp.com teaches by video, lesson by lesson. AMP picks every problem from the learner's last answers.

name: Mr. D Math
line: Mr. D Math is a teacher-led course in a fixed order. AMP chooses each problem from the last answer.

name: Shormann Math
line: Shormann Math teaches 100 video lessons in a fixed order. AMP chooses each problem from the learner's answers.

name: TabletClass Math
line: TabletClass Math is a video course in a set order. AMP finds the level and picks each problem from the last answer.

name: Teaching Textbooks
line: Teaching Textbooks gives every student the same lessons; AMP chooses each next problem from the learner's answers.

name: Thinkwell
line: Thinkwell teaches by professor video in a set order. AMP chooses every problem from the learner's last answer.

name: UnLock Math
line: UnLock Math teaches grades 6–12 by video, in course order. AMP finds the level and chooses every problem.

name: Connections Academy
line: Connections Academy is a full-time online public school. AMP is only math, for home or beside any school.

name: Easy Peasy All-in-One Homeschool
line: Easy Peasy is a free daily plan for every subject. AMP is only math, and it adapts and checks at every answer.

name: K12
line: K12 runs full online schools; AMP is only math, chosen from each learner's answers, beside any school.

name: Miacademy
line: Miacademy covers every subject at a grade the parent picks. AMP is only math, set by the learner's answers.

name: Power Homeschool
line: Power Homeschool teaches many subjects by video from lesson one; AMP teaches only math, at each learner's level.

name: Study.com
line: Study.com teaches all subjects by video in a set order. AMP is only math and picks each problem from the last answer.

name: Abeka
line: Abeka moves every child through the same 170 days of lessons. AMP sets a level in each part of math.

name: Art of Problem Solving
line: AoPS teaches strong students hard problems, course by course. AMP meets any learner at their level, answer by answer.

name: Beast Academy
line: Beast Academy teaches through comics and hard puzzles to age 13. AMP sets each problem and runs to precalculus.

name: BJU Press Math
line: BJU Press Math follows a set course for each grade. AMP chooses every next problem from the learner's own answers.

name: Christian Light Math
line: Christian Light Math is a low-cost print course the adult teaches and grades. AMP checks and explains every answer.

name: Horizons Math
line: Horizons Math is taught and graded by a parent from the book. AMP checks every answer and plans review per child.

name: Life of Fred
line: Life of Fred teaches math through a story, in one order for every child. AMP sets the level and checks each answer.

name: Math Lessons for a Living Education
line: A parent teaches Math Lessons for a Living Education from a storybook. AMP places, checks and reviews on its own.

name: Math Mammoth
line: Math Mammoth is a book the adult places, checks and reviews. AMP does all three, one answer at a time.

name: Math with Confidence
line: Math with Confidence is a scripted K-6 book a parent teaches. AMP finds the level and checks every answer.

name: Math-U-See
line: Math-U-See is taught by a parent with blocks and video. AMP checks every answer and picks the next problem itself.

name: RightStart Mathematics
line: RightStart is taught by a parent with an abacus and card games. AMP places, checks and schedules review itself.

name: Saxon Math
line: Saxon prints the same mixed review for every child; AMP times each skill's review to the learner's answers.

name: Singapore Math
line: Singapore Math is printed books an adult places and grades. AMP places, checks and reviews at every answer.

name: The Good and the Beautiful Math
line: The Good and the Beautiful Math is a book a parent teaches, free as a PDF. AMP places, checks and schedules review.

name: AdaptedMind
line: AdaptedMind makes elementary math practice a game; AMP runs to precalculus on published mastery and review rules.

name: Mathseeds
line: Mathseeds teaches ages 3 to 9 lesson by lesson. AMP picks every problem from the answers, from counting to precalculus.

name: Matific
line: Matific teaches through short games. AMP picks each problem from the last answer and schedules review.

name: Prodigy Math
line: Prodigy puts math questions inside a fantasy game; AMP is all math, each answer explained and used to pick the next.

name: Reflex
line: Reflex builds fast recall of math facts. AMP teaches all of math, counting through precalculus, and works beside it.

name: SplashLearn
line: SplashLearn turns PreK to grade 5 math into games. AMP explains every miss and runs from counting to precalculus.

name: Sumdog
line: Sumdog wraps practice in games and coins. AMP teaches each skill, explains every miss and schedules review.

name: XtraMath
line: XtraMath drills math facts against a clock. AMP teaches and practices all of math, from counting to precalculus.

name: Cuemath
line: Cuemath sells live tutor classes two or three times a week. AMP is daily practice that places, checks and reviews.

name: Kumon
line: Kumon builds calculation speed with repeated worksheets and twice-weekly center visits. AMP explains every answer.

name: Mathnasium
line: Mathnasium teaches in scheduled sessions, in a center or online. AMP gives checked, explained practice any day.

name: Outschool
line: Outschool is a marketplace of live classes. AMP is one math program that chooses every problem, every day.

name: Russian School of Mathematics
line: Russian School of Mathematics teaches a class at one level. AMP sets each problem from the last answer.

name: Sylvan Learning
line: Sylvan tutors in booked sessions, priced by the hour. AMP gives daily practice at home for $59 a month.

name: Thinkster Math
line: Thinkster pairs worksheets with a weekly tutor. AMP chooses every problem itself, for $59 a month.

name: ChatGPT
line: A chatbot answers what a child asks; AMP chooses each problem, checks every answer and schedules review.

name: Photomath
line: Photomath solves the problem a learner photographs. AMP chooses the next problem and asks the learner to solve it.

name: Synthesis Tutor
line: Synthesis Tutor makes K–5 math playful; AMP runs to precalculus, with a stated mastery rule and scheduled review.
